Do not create new site-factory requests this cycle. Maintain the candidates as deferred specifications only. After CTO releases a slot, verify the applicable launch-readiness artifact before any build admission; do not publish, deploy, add credentials, add domains, spend, or alter telemetry.

Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case with root cause, isolated validation, build checks, rollback point, and release-boundary evidence by 2026-10-01T09:00Z. Release one delivery slot before admitting any additional implementation work.

The preserved allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement is technically suitable for the existing queue after capacity clears: bounded, reversible, isolated to one site, and measurable using the existing baseline. Do not claim revenue lift, ROI, or causal impact because analytics is unavailable and current affiliate evidence is limited to site-level clicks with zero site-attributed commission for the recorded window.

Maintain the private launch and security gates. No new public exposure, credentials, permissions, dependencies, cross-site behavior, external outreach, or telemetry collection is authorized. Preserve aggregate affiliate revenue as unattributed and require registered tracking IDs for future links.
